federation.title: Federation trust
federation.invalidSite: Enter a name, valid site UUID, and an HTTPS origin without a path, query, or credentials.
federation.invalidKey: Enter a key ID, public PEM, at least one purpose, and an expiry after the start time.
federation.invalidCertificate: Enter a certificate in PEM format.
federation.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the entries and try again.
federation.loadFailed: Could not load. Refresh to try again.
federation.desktopOnly: View only on mobile. Use a desktop to change federation trust.

impact.suspend: This institution will fail federation trust checks. Renewals for running work may also be affected.
impact.resume: Restore institution trust. Keys, certificates, and business agreements must still be valid.
impact.revokeSite: This cannot be undone. Federation authentication for this institution will be rejected.
impact.revokeKey: This cannot be undone. Messages using this key will fail verification, including historical messages checked again.
impact.revokeCertificate: This cannot be undone. This client certificate will no longer authenticate the institution.

storage.title: Input storage reconciliation
storage.listScope: Showing the oldest {{count}} unknown requests (up to 100); look up other generations directly.
storage.empty: No unknown storage requests to reconcile
storage.stoppedAt: Writers stopped and requests drained at (local)
storage.cleaned: This attempt is cleaned; releasing the import quota still depends on its remaining attempts.
storage.awaitCleanup: Attestation recorded. Actual storage cleanup is still required; recording it does not release quota.
storage.desktopOnly: Read-only on mobile. Record operator attestations on desktop.
storage.boundary: Isolate previous writers, confirm in-flight requests have drained at storage, and retain evidence. Empty listings or timeouts do not prove requests stopped. Quota is released only after actual cleanup succeeds.
storage.ineligible: Not eligible: input cancellation, confirmed execution stop, an expired lease and an unknown request outcome are required. Refresh after the state changes.
storage.allWritersStopped: All original writers are isolated and stopped, and will remain unable to write.
storage.storageRequestsDrained: Storage-side in-flight requests are drained and reliable evidence has been retained.
storage.invalid: Provide a valid incident ID, sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal digits, and a stop time between lease expiry and now. Both attestations are required.
storage.saveFailed: Recording could not be confirmed. Retry the same statement; if the request changed, close this dialog and refresh to reconcile again.
storage.confirmEffect: This trusts your writer isolation and drain checks, records an audit entry and permits background cleanup. It does not prove storage is already clean.

permissions.title: Federation permissions
permissions.refineSearch: More organizations are available. Refine your search.
permissions.removeEffect: Only this explicit grant is removed; other grants may still include the same capability. Removing a grant does not confirm running tasks are cancelled.
permissions.noGrants: No federation grants in this organization
permissions.desktopOnly: Read-only on mobile. Change federation permissions on desktop.

agreement.read: Read this organization’s agreements and signatures; does not permit approval.
agreement.approve: Sign for this organization, attach counterparty signatures and change local agreement state; includes agreement reading. Platform roles do not automatically grant this authority.

asset.read: Read federation materials in this organization; local software and data require separate authorization.
asset.map: Register or revoke this organization’s material mappings; includes reading materials, without granting resource usage rights.

delegation.read: Read this organization’s delegations; does not permit submission or cancellation.
delegation.submit: Submit, read and cancel this organization’s delegations, subject to agreements, budgets and resource authorization.
delegation.cancel: Cancel and read this organization’s delegations; does not permit submission.

result.read: Read delivered results within this organization’s authorized scope; does not permit contract approval.
